import json
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

main = Path('/home/linhao/Toolchain/development/LogAnalysisSkill')
stage = main / 'docs/clang-fix-campaign/dev_memory/stage14_p49_terminal_batch'
path = main / 'docs/clang-fix-campaign/tools/p49_terminal_data/control_catalog.json'
xml = stage / 'a0-evidence/part3/erratum5/foundation-tests-final.xml'
cases = {x.attrib['name']: x for x in ET.parse(xml).iter('testcase')}
catalog = json.loads(path.read_text())
existing = {row['control_id'] for row in catalog}
added = []
def add(control_id, name, source):
    assert control_id not in existing
    case = cases[name]
    assert len(case) == 0
    row = {'control_id': control_id, 'group': 'E4-ENTRY-CLASSIFIER', 'source': source,
           'test_nodeid': 'tests/unit/test_terminal_scan.py::' + name,
           'fixture_kind': 'ARTIFICIAL_ONLY', 'status': 'PASS', 'exit_code': 0,
           'evidence': 'a0-evidence/part3/erratum5/foundation-tests-final.xml',
           'scope': 'entry classifier only; no complete detector matrix or SEAL assertion'}
    added.append(row)

for name in cases:
    if name.startswith('test_e4_each_entry_kind['):
        kind = name.split('[', 1)[1][:-1]
        add('CTRL-E4-KIND-' + kind, name, 'Erratum4 E4-2')
add('CTRL-E4-UNKNOWN-MODE', 'test_e4_unknown_git_mode_is_blocked', 'Erratum4 E4-2 total classifier')
add('CTRL-E4-ORDER-DOCS-MAKEFILE', 'test_e4_first_match_wins[docs/Makefile-100644--BUILD]', 'Erratum4 E4-2 first match')
e5 = [
    ('1', 'test_e5_release_absolute_import_stays_release'),
    ('1-prime', 'test_e5_release_missing_name_falls_back_live'),
    ('2', 'test_e5_live_absolute_import_stays_live'),
    ('3', 'test_e5_path_can_cross_context'),
    ('4', 'test_e5_duplicate_within_context_is_ambiguous'),
]
for number, name in e5:
    assert len(cases[name]) == 0
    control_id = 'CTRL-E5-' + number
    assert control_id not in existing
    added.append({'control_id': control_id, 'group': 'E5-CONTEXT-RESOLUTION',
        'source': 'Erratum5 E5-4', 'status': 'NOT_RUN',
        'reason': 'End-to-end consumer edge control pending SCAN-03 ruling; only resolver unit exercised.',
        'component_check': {'test_nodeid': 'tests/unit/test_terminal_scan.py::' + name,
                            'status': 'PASS', 'exit_code': 0,
                            'evidence': 'a0-evidence/part3/erratum5/foundation-tests-final.xml'}})
path.write_text(json.dumps(catalog + added, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
assert json.loads(path.read_text())[:len(catalog)] == catalog
print('PREEXISTING_CONTROL_RECORDS_UNCHANGED=' + str(len(catalog)))
print('E4_CLASSIFIER_CONTROLS=14 PASS')
print('E5_END_TO_END=5 NOT_RUN; E5_RESOLVER_COMPONENT=5 PASS')
print('CTRL-INTRA-PKG-PROXY=NOT_RUN (unchanged)')
